text:
What I have tried - 
Honey hot wings
Shrimp pasta
Chicken pasta
Crab fries
Buffalo chicken 

I was never disappointed with anything, EVERYTIME I ate I promise I did not breathe at all. I don't know how it's possible so don't ask me just know I didn't 

I will eat this place everyday and because I did I'm on a diet and I can't until I lose my "Tia" weight.

We've been here twice for birthday dinners and the food was amazing. Steak melted in your mouth, the Mac and cheese was scrumptious and the apps we tried were delectable. Staff are super professional, polite and prompt. The atmosphere is romantic and dark. This place is perfect for a date night!

We went here a few weeks back because it was receiving a lot of hype. It was OK, nothing really special IMO. We had the beef curry and the bacon dish (which I can't recall the name of). The bacon was like waaaay too much bacon. The beef curry OK, but a little tough. Both meals were low in the temperature scale, like they had been sitting out for a while. 

The seating needs to be revamped. The place had mostly 4 tops, occupied by pairs. There is no hostess at the front door, so it's a little weird when you walk in, and need to go to the back takeout counter. 

All that being said, we will definitely be back for another try. This place has potential, and they can only get better.

HEY Coffee Co. is amazing. I love this location because it's right on the Greenway. So fun to stop for an iced coffee on my way down to the Quarter. My favorite is their cold brew with a splash of cream. It's delicious!!!

COVID Stuff:
The inside is very small and is currently closed due to COVID, so they are only doing walk up service. They have tables outside and in the grass. It's really cute, actually. Gotta have a mask! 

Really though, I love this coffee co and everything they stand for. They lost their shop uptown this year so drop on by and support them on the Greenway :)

Very courteous and accommodating host/manager/server.  We had a large party with kids, so they offered multiple seating options, trying their best to seat us quickly.  Food was good, service was great, and our entire dining experience (first time) was pleasant.

Books & Brews is always one of my favorite places to go in Brownsburg! They have great local beers and the staff are always super friendly, and genuinely seem to enjoy talking to customers. The trivia nights are so much fun and the mug club is an amazing deal!

First off let me say that what made me interested in this place is that they have many vegetarian/vegan options. It's not many pizza stores that have those options. There was also different options like a fried shrimp sandwich. That's what I ordered with fries. It was pretty good. The fries were very crunchy like I like. I would recommend. They were also very friendly. I will be coming back soon!

I ordered mozzarella cheese fries and wings. The fries were glued to a piece of tinfoil with the mozzarella cheese. I ordered  the mild wings. I know some may like a sweet sauce. I am not one of those people . It did not taste like a conventional mild wing sauce in my opinion and was too sweet. They were atleast edible since the fries needed a chisel to get them off the tinfoil. As much as I would like to support a local spot, I can't with this meal.

This is the worst experience ever, if you like waiting over 20 mins on your food then go ahead. The guy in here is so stoned he can't even spell my name right. Oh and after 30 minutes of waiting I left and got my money back.

Ok, let's start off by I am a donut snob, I think donuts are a piece of history and art and a lot of places ruin them. I will not name them but they're a lot of chains and "famous" places i could care less for. However, these are the best donuts i have ever had. I'm serious they are light, airy, and fresh every-time. The chocolate and  vanilla frosting are unbelievable and just taste "homemade". Their cinnamon swirls are so additive I'm went into a deep depression after eating 5 in an hour time. I HIGHLY recommend this place. I wish I could speak in their other treats but I go there for one reason only and it's to get the BEST donuts. I will be back. Their Boston creams are perfect too, the filling is perfect and doesn't taste like it was mass produced and sat in a plastic bag for months. I will be back!

Really efficient. Not good if it rains because the line queues outside. I got the East nasty and it was delicious. Also, bonuts - dense but def great to share with a friend (or 3). Come hungry! Also, the sausage gravy was some of the best I've ever had. The dish my husband got (forget the name) was good but very very sweet (the lily maybe?)

Wonderful food. It is a hole in the wall store. You have to order your food and pay. Food arrives at your table. 
Pad Thai and red curry are awesome. Portion size is very good. It is not a trendy place and very popular among college students.

They include ingredients in the dish not listed on the menu. It is incredibly easy to advertise the dish will be full of diced onions so that the customer knows to request it without, if they want. Much more difficult to do so and remove after the fact if they are a surprise addition

Not real Venezuelan arepas. Is a mixture of Greek fast food and they have arepas , the seasoning wasn't as I expected. I gave it 2 stars but the person who took care of us was friendly . (NOT VENEZUELAN)  if you want Venezuelan atmosphere try something else .

Overall nice ambience - excellent food.  We came with an eight tear old - inquired about a children's menu.  Instead of pointing out what we might enjoy, waiter gave us the "he shouldn't be here" look and attitude.  "Service" afterwards was downhill - rude - worst I've ever encountered - he basically threw everything at us.  To top it off, one of us got sick.  We'll never go back!

Great place and the cake was amazing. I was referred to this place so I thought I would try it out. More expensive to buy here than at a normal store but the cake was worth it and the personal touch was pleasing. The ladies were very nice. I would recommend and definitely will give them more business.

Thank you to London Heights for the support and being the home for the "Unofficial Gator Watch Party".  Another party and another Gator win!  The food was great again and we had a good time cheering on the Gators.  Big game this weekend with Auburn.  Hope to see more Gator fans this Saturday!  3:30pm kickoff as it is the headline CBS game and ESPN Gameday will be televising from Gainesville as well.  Go Gators!
The coffee here is delicious. The service is respectful, knowledgeable, and fun. The space is unique and airy. What else need I say!?

Ive only had takeout, once, and I cannot wait to visit again. The fried rice, green curry, and tom yum soup are amazing. I wish I could recreate these dishes on my own but I'll just leave that to Cafe Ayla! I'm so glad I finally got to try the food here and highly recommend everyone checks it out!

Summary: The food and drink are very good; the service is very poor.

I've been to Bardea five times over several months. 

Pros: The kitchen knows what it's doing. The food is very good. The whole fish offerings are delicious, but you have to remove the fish from the bone and serve the table yourself. The oysters on the half shell have been consistently good. The selections of wine by the glass are interesting and good. The bartenders also make good cocktails, and the service at the bar is good.

Cons: But the table service is bad -- every time for me. I have had to wait an uncomfortably long time after being seated for anyone to acknowledge me and my guests. Dishes appear willy-nilly, with no thought for order or pacing. I've had the juices from the whole fish spilled in my lap. The front of the house does not live up to the quality of the kitchen.

They advertise that they are open until midnight on Saturdays. I went there recently with a group after a concert, hoping to have drinks at the bar and some small plates. We discovered that they only serve pizza after 10:00 p.m., and last call at the bar came at 11:00 p.m.

I want this restaurant to work, but it doesn't.
I'm new to the area and a friend of mine recommended me here. I tried a vegetarian dish, wasn't too spicy which is what I was hoping for. Well it was delicious. I will be back

Mama's is my favorite Korean restaurant in Indy. There are 3 others I've been to - Bando (also in Pendleton Pike), Sisters (Greenwood), and Cafe Korea (Fishers). The food at Mama's is authentic and flavorful, with generous portion sizes. 

First off, the banchan. These side dishes are a hallmark of Korean cuisine, and you get 12 of them. This is far more than many other Korean restaurants, even outside of Indy. There is a variety of banchan, with both cabbage and radish kimchi always included. They charge you for extra banchan, but they provide them in such generous portions that I rarely need to ask for seconds. 

We recently got the pork sauté, dolsot bibimbop, and seng daegu maeuntang. Pork sauté is always a safe choice, because it's flavorful, slightly spicy, and very tasty! It's less salty and oily than the pork and kimchi sauté (also delicious, btw). 

Dolsot bibimbop is also a safe choice. It comes with a variety of veggies, marinated beef, rice at the bottom, and an egg on top. The heat of the pot makes crispy rice at the bottom! I highly recommend this over the non-dolsot, "cold" version. This comes pre-mixed with gochujang, so if you can't handle too much spice I would ask for it on the side. 

Seng daegu maeuntang is a spicy broth with cod, clam, tofu, and radish. It's a lighter broth but flavorful and spicy. The cod is cooked to be very tender. This is a pretty large portion, so I would recommend sharing. 

Overall, my meal was great! I've been here many times and

Historic. Great proximity to event we needed to attend. High marks on so many levels in reviews, so high expectations of charm, hospitality, convenience and anticipating a delightful experience. 

I have NEVER  written a YELP review. NOT EVEN to help a friend with their business, nor inflate a rating for any business, NOR to complain about service. I guess I just felt that $$ for The Logan Inn should be $$$ for a quadruple minus of an experience. Anyplace can have their "game on" when visited by someone who may write a review for a magazine or newspaper; in addition, colleagues in the industry can be very "you pat my back, I'll pat yours" with regard to NOT addressing short-comings and a sense of exclusivity(i.e. ELITISM) that comes with "believing their own press". 

So it is understandable the Inn was booked for the second night we needed for our visit, but NO recommendations were volunteered for other local accommodations(as a good hotel neighbor might offer). 

NO follow up communication from the Inn once they had our deposit, but to solicit a visit to their Spa. Request for early arrival was noted, however NO attempt to honor the request was addressed for our convenience. 
NO mention that the parties accommodated at the Logan Inn attending this event near-by should expect a shuttle provided by the event hosts to commute the hotel guests to the event at a certain time. 
NO consideration of cross-continental travelers with some "baggage" for an event being accommodated on

You might not even know this Pizza Place is there! It's kind of hidden but I'm glad we found it! They are following all the Covid rules and they wear their masks and gloves. Their pizza is delicious! I would recommend it to everyone! Their chicken wings are huge and delicious! We look forward to eating here. Give then A+

So yummy!!  Breadsticks are amazing.  Soaked in garlic butter and parmesan and HUGE!  Pizza is good, I only eat it with extra sauce because it is pretty doughy and needs the extra sauce (on traditional crust at least, haven't tried the others).  This medium (12inch), family order of breadsticks (12), and extra cheese sauce was $28.

Meh, meh, meh!  Food quality has gone off the cliff since they moved to the new location.  By way of example, I ordered takeout and was informed they had no guacamole.  WTH Mexican restaurant runs out of guacamole?  I feel bad because this place was awesome for so long.  Go to all Tolteca instead

I'm not sure how this place could only get 3 stars. The pizza is really good. The service is even better. Not that I managed to take advantage of it, but you can seat yourself and have your order taken by one of the staff. I know it doesn't sound spectacular in regards to restaurants, but this is a pizza joint. There's not many pizza spots in Philly that takes that approach to service, and I've been to a ton in Philadelphia alone. You're more likely to find a pizza restaurant where you order at the counter and they bring it over to you. 

I'm not a person who cares about having that level of service from a pizza joint, but the fact that Renzi's takes service this seriously stands out to me.

Did I mention the pizza was really good?

The wings were still crispy by the time we got home and tasted delicious! The house made ranch is great too, I always appreciate a good ranch! I would have liked the hot wings to be a little saucier, but other than that we loved it!

I had a pleasant experience here. There was very little wine around lunchtime. We got our food fast. There was a lot of parking spaces open. I ordered a salad which I would suggest to those of you going. You have to get up and pick up your order at the window once they call your number. This can usually caused confusion around dinner time as it's crowded but lunchtime it was very easy and simple. I would suggest this location.

Not sure why Yelp is saying that the majority of 5-star reviews for Big Catch aren't recommended-super sketchy on Yelp's part, but this place is awesome. We've come here a few times now and the food and service are always good. The fish is fresh and the toppings are plentiful, and their sauces are very unique. The owners is always willing to let you try things and will tell you if a combo you want to won't be good. Beyond psyched to have a great poke place down the street!

It was just uh. We have been trying new pizza places every week and it this landed at bottom to middle spot so far. Definitely not the worst but also definitely not the worst. Just blah, boring pizza that wasn't terrible but not remarkable either.

Tex Mex BBQ May sound questionable but you NEED to try this out! First of all, the staff is great -- Anthony is the nicest waiter & gives the best recommendations! Everything is made in-house though, so you really can't go wrong! I got chips & queso to start -- if that queso was on everything I ever ate for the rest of my life, I'd die happy. 

For the main course, I got the smoked brisket tacos. The brisket was done perfectly! If you're not feeling tacos, they do offer sandwiches with all the same meats too. 

Great atmosphere, staff & food!!! Will definitely be back :)

Unfortunately, this place will be closed within 6 months, a year MAX.  

   I went in for the first time for lunch, busy but not packed, about 8 people with two servers.  One, possibly one of the family members, a friendly Asian young man.  The first thing that hit me was, there was food, ALL OVER the floor; I mean all over.  The young mans apron, shirt and pants were filthy, I mean FILTHY, food splattered all over, as was the other server, a polite young man.  Plus both of them were standing around most of the time, try cleaning. I should have tipped (old school for left) right there, but I'll give it a try.  I had to ask what were the lunch specials and I ordered a curry chicken dish; it came with an egg roll and a cup of soup.  Soup came out quickly, it was a cabbage gruel.  It made me think,  this is what was served to prisoners on Devils Island.  Bland, broth,no flavor and with some cabbage thrown in.  After a spoonful, Mmmm, maybe I can make this tolerable and spice it up.  Went to the condiment "carrier" on the table.  FILTHY.  Metal cover for hot sauce, disgusting.  Bottles smeared with grease.  The place is TWO WEEKS OLD!!!!!  Really!  Then, without warning (: the curry came out.  After, 2 mins of the soup; training???  Mind you, I specifically asked for a spicy dish, then I asked to spice it up on top of that.  This was the Chef Boy-R-Dee of Vietnamese food.  No flavor, NONE, watery curry "sauce" boiled chicken, just awful, really gross.  PLUS, the egg roll was a fr

On a night Door Dash went down, they were communicative and extraordinarily nice, letting us come pick it up safely by bringing it to the car PLUS without asking they remade the entire order because it had been sitting out while Door Dash crashed. Really cool dudes and the food was very good!

Honestly pretty disappointed in this place. A couple people told me to go here so I trusted it would be great. But my bagel was pretty burnt, the jalapeño cream cheese that I got tasted like peppers? And for the price it just isn't worth it- over $5 for a bagel with flavored cream cheese is outrageous. I wanted to try the lox sandwich but that was over $14..I spend less in Manhattan

Beautiful place! Went here the first nice day of the year and was not disappointed. Went for drinks, got the White Door it was very strong and tasty Pat did an awesome job.

Quick service, even when it was packed. Definitely the move for a group happy hour or a fun pregame.
This place is incredible. The spam musubi, BBQ chicken, and poke are all amazing dishes. It is also authentic which is awesome. I definitely recommend coming to this DELICIOUS restaurant.
Woah. I am so glad we visited this lovely gem! The food is delicious! The coffee is hot and perfect. The baked treats are heavenly.  A must visit for brunch when you are in Nashville!!

Came to Bourbon Steak to celebrate my 30th birthday. All 7 of us had a fantastic meal and enjoyed everything from our wonderful server, Ellie and her server assistant Michael. You should definitely request Ellie, she's so smart and funny. The food was delicious as well, we got a smorgasbord of items and there wasn't one thing  that went uneaten. Thank you to bourbon steak for making this night special!
Came here with Fiancée and had a pleasant meal. Great service all around and or steak was cooked perfectly, and delicious trout. Our server Jordan was very friendly and accommodating.

This place must be called Nada because that's exactly what's on their menu, Nada damn thing. The food wasn't much to write home about but their queso was good. Margs were small and expensive, but you'll have that in Nashville.

It's hard to believe this place is a chain because everything is so good. I can recommend any burger and the salmon Caesar salad is also fantastic. Ample seating and excellent service also make this place a great choice!

I really wish Yelp would put in half stars.  This is really a 3.5. I am not sure if its the Covid era or what but the last 2 times I have been here the food has gone down a notch. The detail to food and portion size is smaller.

Still better than other Italian chain restaurants but not as good as the independent Italian restaurants in the area. I would come back if someone else wanted to.

Fire.. but also I have a serious question and not sure if anyone can help me out.. SO what is the attire supposed to be? I am caught not going because I don't know if I over dress or underdress.. is it casual, or is it button down or does a polo work? Also are jeans frowned upon?

Only reason I give them 2 stars is because the servers was really trying and the manager ended up comping most of the bill. I understand they just opened for outdoor setting and it was really hard for them to adapt to the change but it was no excuse for them to be understaff first we ordered drinks and that took 10 mins to come them we gave our appetizer order I ordered potado skins and the other people at my table ordered dumplings that took a good 20 mins that comes out and they forget one order of dumplings but brings another order of potato skins. Then we ordered entrees that took almost an hour to get out when it did my aunts chicken was burnt to the crisp like all black and we told the manager and he gonna say that's how it's suppose to be yeah ok then I ordered the chicken and shrimp pasta and it came out very very bland and barely no meat so I sent that back and ordered chicken tenders and fries instead 30 mins past they come out and say our fryer is down I'm like forget it i just paid for my 2 drinks and went to the Burger King across the parking lot was very disappointed in the service but the server tried very hard being short staffed and training someone on top of that and the manager was nice

The person who served us was the rudest server I have ever encountered. He was standing at the register/serving window, and when we asked him if we could order he gave an annoyed look and pointed to a sign which said order by phone or online only (that's fine, but weird, since instead of us telling him from 6 feet away or more what we wanted, we had to call him and tell him the order from barely more than 6 feet away!). That's the policy which is fine, but it's hard to explain how put-out he behaved by having to refer us to a sign. After 30 min (we were the only ones there when we ordered) he handed five crepes to my wife in one styrofoam container with no napkins. There were four of us eating outside the establishment. There are no tables or places to sit, so I went back to the window and asked the server for an extra styrofoam container so that we could use it as an "extra plate" to share our 5 crepes between 4 people. He told us he didn't have enough supplies to give us an extra container or napkins. I explained that it was hard to eat the crepes between us with nothing to put the crepes on and without napkins. He looked at me like I was insane and then ignored me. Being honest here, I cussed him out and left. Funny thing is they were some of the best crepes I've ever had, but I will never visit this establishment again.
I have to stop at Slim & Husky's every-time I'm in the Nashville area. Their pizza is delicious. My favorite is the California Love with shrimp! The atmosphere is soulful but seating is limited!

My first visit to the Roxborough location to try their gyro.  There is on street parking on Ridge Avenue.  The restaurant is bright and cheery with the color scheme.  

I decided on the beef/lamb gyro woth tzatziki sauce and the greek yogurt with strawberries, bananas, honey, and granola for my daughter.  The menu allows you to either put it in pita or plate it. They offer chicken, pork, beef/lamb, and falafel.  Then select sauce. You can add fries to the entree. I passed on the extra calories.   There are a number of sides as well as salads.  Plus two different desserts.

On my next visit I will eat in so I can enjoy the food after it is prepared.  Also, I want to try sides  and dessert.
Wonderful ramen, excellent staff, you guys are a hidden gem!!  We will definitely be back!

I've never been to a Pei Wei, but I wasn't let down! It was great Asian food for the price. I spent about 13 dollars including tax. I got the sweet and sour chicken rice bowl. I also got the fried rice instead of white/brown rice which was an extra $1 and I got a drink. I was pretty happy with the price considering the portion size was fairly big! Also it was nice that the food came out incredibly quick. Great food for the price!!
Waiter did not check on our order. No bread was served before hand. Service was not what I would expect. Not  satisfied. Food was Just OK. My recommendation is to look around.

Today I went in and spent 50.00 in crawfish and the crawfish was spoiled I then called Cajun shake and the man told me maybe it was my taste buds I then told him that 3 other ppl tasted it and they said it was spoiled . The man told me this is fresh crawfish and it was me and my tastebuds instead of his food ....the crawfish guts where pink inside it and was also dark colored with a sour taste. I'm highly dissatisfied and will not be returning

Standing here waiting for 10 minutes to be acknowledged as numerous servers passed us.  Then we were told to go wait outside. How  about putting a sign up with your directions or at least acknowledge your guests so we do stand there looking like idiots. Pass on this place.
Went here recently and had a Shrimp Po Boy. It was like eating a po boy right off the coast. Service was absolutely fantastic from our server Paige. Highly recommend if you're in the area.

Loved everything about this place!  This was our first time to visit and we were so pleased!  The food was excellent (served nice and hot!), the ambiance was great and the service was perfect!

We had a group of 6 and there was plenty of room for us.  We had the sampler platter entree which was plenty for all.  Then amongst us we had:  Green Curry, Orange Chicken, and several fried rice. 

I'm glad we found this place!  We'll go again!

Cash only. Outside dining tables removed. I had Monday special meatball sandwich w chips and 20oz RC. I've had the meatball sandwich here before and loved it. Today was dry.  Used to be much better. Literally no sauce. Young man I had never seen made it for me. Meat was pretty tasty but I've had fresher bread and more sauce at Subway. Wife had ham and cheese. She didn't think the wheat bread was that fresh but said it was "ok."Not in a hurry to return as tables removed from outside dining and cash only. Big sign stating "No extra napkins or plastic utensils given out".  2 sandwiches and 2 Jalapeño beer sticks (rubbery) came to $20.00. I've been coming here several years for sandwiches and sides and always very satisfied. Maybe it's just the COVID crud but it'll be awhile if I return. Disappointed today for sure.

Very pricey for what we ended up receiving. $18 for 3 small "stuffed" mushrooms? The scallops and linguine were very disappointing, scallops were the size of nickels and had a taste taste that threw off everything. 

They also didn't inform my table there was an up charge to pay with a card. There were times me an my date went 20 minutes without our waitress even interacting with us.  I'm usually not a harsh critic but this wasn't their best, very very very disappointing Vday meal to say the least.
Everything is amazing but these are our favorites French onion soup, croque monsieur, beet salad, Victorian salad, prime rib sandwich. The specials are always delicious as well.

I had to downgrade my rating for the simple fact that I thought the original cooking fee of $1.00 was bizzarre and now they have upped it to 2.00. No other seafood place does this not even the supermarket. And how does it make any sense that they won't even bother to cook a 1/2 dozen small or medium crabs. It's just a no.  Since I have no fear of cooking my own I can easily opt out but I think it's a lame policy especially in this competitive market. Just saying.

This place is a huge disappointment. I went to this restaurant because it was close to where I live and oh boy, how wrong i was. We ordered sushi sampler and the fish was smelly probably because it had been sitting for awhile. There was a fish BONE in one of the sushi pieces. This never happed to me at a sushi restaurant. To top it off, i got food poising for 2 days afterward.  I would give it a 0 if i could.

Don't let Brooklyns be the secret you don't know about... this place is great. 

I've driven by a hundred times and had no idea of the gem that I had missed. Great burgers and beer and in a place where you can comfortably watch a game. I'd recommend it for a casual dinner or lunch.

Food was very very fresh! We had the nachos and the way they laid out the nachos on a pizza plate so all the chips for cheese and all the fixings is genius! Every chip has more than enough meat cheese and other on it! The reason I did a 4 star because $7.50 for chips and salsa is a little ridiculous. All in all great Mexican food just the high price on chips and salsa is the only downfall of this place.

Is there a better deli in the area that gives you quality food at a fair price? This is one of my favorite places to eat. Excellent value for the money. So many decisions to make of fresh food choices. You can eat inside or outside.
Hot or cold meals of your choice. Definitely worth a try.

Not what I expected at all. Too dark in there and the tables are small. The food was alright, needed seasoning, nothing special. Just like another comment, need a better bun to support burger. Our server was great, very attentive and friendly (African American man with glasses)

This place is phenomenal! Come here often and always have a good experience. The staff is super friendly and nice! The ramen is always tasty and nearly addictive. Definitely one of the better ramen spots in the area! Would recommend the tonkatsu ramen or the spicy crispy chicken black garlic ramen! The udon is also really tasty!

We just came from San Francisco and so excited to try this barbecue restaurant since this is our first time here. At the door there was a small counter with a lady who was supposed to entertain us but as i approached and ask her if i can order to go, she said our to go order is closed and we're closing at 9 pm but it was only 8:45 pm and there's still people dining in. So i tell her that i still have 15 mins more to order my food and she said that if i want i can dine in for 15 mins. I have no idea why she wants me to dine in when all of closing restaurants prefer to go orders instead to avoid dirty dishes. Then the other lady let us sit and ready to serve us but when i ask her if they can just put food to go instead. And she answered me " i am not your server". Who will take my order if i only have 15 mins left before they close? Such a frustrating experience!! I really want to try this at first but i changed my mind not to go back here and will never recommend this place. Greet, smile and a little talk of acceptance is needed here!
Ohh dear Hellas  my favorite spot in Tarpon Springs! The food in their restaurant is so Soo very delicious and their bakery is TO DIE FOR! It's always packed but it's always worth it.

We got takeout ramen when we visited Tucson for a day last month. Specifically, we tried Obon Ramen and Tonkatsu Ramen. We understand that ramen is very hard (or even impossible) to make very nice if it is a takeout. It is expected that the soup will be separate. However, in this particular case the ingredients in the box were stuck to each other, it looked like it was pre-packaged a while ago. The egg wasn't marinated and, more importantly, it was almost completely raw! The soup wasn't nearly hot enough to cook the egg -- there was a delay for them to pack the food, send us a notification to come and pick it up, for us to get back to the hotel (10 mins driving). Realistically the customers can't be expected to put the egg inside the soup earlier than 20 minutes after the food is ready. The soup got cold rather rapidly. Also there was very little amount of meat for the price. The Obon soup was rather oily for our taste. While we don't know the ramen market in Tucson, in general, there are many ways this particular experience could have been better.

Went here a few times when I was visiting friends and family in Florida and absolutely loved it!! Some people are saying that it's just ok but I honestly have no idea what they're talking about. It is so delicious and awesome quality food!! (Especially the sushi ) only stopped ordering cause my tiny body can only eat so much!! Anyway, amazing food (didn't take photos cause I was totally lost in the moment with friends) and please keep being awesome!!
Favorite Mediterranean spot in Santa Barbara! Best dish is the salmon plate! Love love it here!!! During this social distancing they are offering home delivery... great spot!

Pros
Easy parking
Nice patio

Cons
Baby back ribs too salty 
Tri tip nacho meat was dry and chips we're stale
Ribs and Mac & cheese were not good for kids (spicy)
$16 kids grilled cheese
Not eco friendly... Heavy duty foil trays disposed after meal, they give you a paper box for leftovers instead of a cover for the foil trays

The #1 was One of the Best Sandwiches I have ever tasted! Caramelized Beef, House Baked Bread with gooey cheese on the inside and shredded cheese on the outside!  Green and Hot Sauces were Very Tasty Too!

Want to step back in time before Nashville was filled with bite-sized portions and $15 entrees? Arnold's is legitimately Nashville in a restaurant. Being a Kentucky girl, I know good fried chicken and theirs is one of the best I've had in Nashville & don't even get me started on their chocolate pie

Was there this past Friday 7/24. Great store and a pleasant experience except for a guy at the Butcher/meat counter that was a complete D_ _K. My wife asked what was in the meatballs that were on the counter and he acted like she had 3 heads or something. Totally rude, clipped and uncalled for. A Real jerk and no interest in customer service. Sorry we bothered you A-hole.
Food ice cold, pizza wasn't cut and gross never again I'll never order from here again

This is their second location, and much closer to me.  I have been going here quite a few times lately.  Love the breakfast, which you can get anytime.  Close to down town also.  And right off the freeway.  Have never had a bad meal at either location.

This place is hands down my favorite place to go for anything bakery related. Pre COVID, the owner hosted themed tea parties. I've attended the Harry Potter Tea and the winter holiday tea. The owner makes her own tea blends in addition to all of the mouthwatering pastries she creates. You can seriously pick out anything from the case blindly and have a delicious treat you'll love.

Just enjoyed our favorite Firkin Tavern wings, Honey Sriracha. The star of the meal, however, was the Jumbo Lump Crab Cake with Remoulade sauce. Garnished with a bit of roasted red pepper, it was moist and flavorful. BEST CRAB CAKE in Mercer County, hands down. The asparagus was perfectly cooked, a real treat, and Firkin's great fries crisped up beautifully with just a few minutes in the air fryer. Take Out is tough on fries, but Firkin's are worth the few minutes to heat up.

Unfortunately my husband and I just had dinner at Rexy's, a place we have gone to for years. This was however our last time until COVID time is passed. At that time we will give them one chance to redeem themselves.  Our entire meal consisting of salad and entree with drinks was served as a to go. I had a chicken dish that I couldn't cut with my plastic knife.   The hostess and manager had masks that their noses were exposed most of time we were there.  When asked by the manager if everything was ok, we told her we were not pleased with the picnic meal serving. She proceeded to lambast us on how their supplies are single use and that's the best way.  Of course it most likely means they've let one of the dishwashers  go since there are no dishes, glassware or flatware to wash. Our waitress apologized repeatedly and offered true flatware but it was too late. The manager was just beyond rude but did raise her mask over her nose when she walked passed us later on.

My boyfriend got the pasta Lenora and I got the crawfish pasta. We both agreed they were some of the best pasta we've ever had. The crab claws were amazing also. If you're on the fence about where to go for dinner/lunch definitely come here!

So this is my first pho restaurant in Tucson coming from Vegas pho restaurants and unfortunately my food was okay. I got the rare steak pho and the meat itself was just not good quality. Seen in photo. It's no wonder they give you so much of it. The broth itself was good though. I also ordered tempura shrimp and unfortunately got tempura calamari. Sadly, I don't like calamari whatsoever but it wasn't horrible but it was what I ordered so that was a bummer. Altogether not worth $21 plus a tip. /: Also, they didn't give any red onions or green onions. I would request it.

This place gets better and better! I had a chance to try a wide variety of their food and it is just incredible. The only bad thing I can say about this place is they aren't open longer and they sell out of food pretty fast. I am happy for their success to sell that much! Mac and 'cheese' is wonderful, the 'chicken' and the burgers, the fries, the homemade ranch, the kale salad.... my mouth is watering! I always bring people here because it truly is my favorite spot in town for vegan food. The desserts are still to DIE FOR!

What the fuck is this? Because I know it's not chicken Labh! This is just chopped boiled chicken with onion, lime and peppers. Where's the toasted rice powder? Why is the meat chopped and not minced? Why is the portion size so small? This isn't Thai food. This is shit. I was craving Thai food and now my craving has just turned to sadness. Save yourself some time and heartache and eat somewhere else. Shit.

It's a nice little deli. Pastrami and Swiss and is huge and well worth the price. Their onion rings are fantastic, crispy and huge and complements the sandwich. Service was great, there's tables outside and it's a nice area.

If I could give a negative rating I would in a heartbeat. This location off orange grove is a few minutes from my house, I have visited this location three times. In those three times I have had 3 incidents. 1- completely forgot a burger. 2- completely messed up my order and both sodas were disgusting. 3- tonight... I spend $42 dollars and ordered California burgers (with bacon) get NO bacon. All other burgers were completely wrong. I called Freddy's 3 times to talk to a manager and the number on the recipient and google are not in service. Seriously the WORST service for something so simple. Especially when the lobby is closed. How hard is it to handle one order at a time? I have worked fast food and not once did I ever send out an order incorrectly. Pathetic that I can't even speak to a manager about these situations (again, I've called or went back all 3 times) The Freddy's on Broadway and Kolb is amazing and nothing is ever messed up. When I'm on the east side I will attend that location but this one... y'all need some new development ASAP. If a member of management would like to contact me, I'd appreciate it. Thanks

I'm not vegan but these donuts are definitely on my list of best donuts in the city! I love how they switch up their flavors daily so it's something new everyday. The dough is super soft, on the sweeter side, and very fluffy. Truly, I would never guess they were vegan. 

My personal favorite are the dunkaroo filled donuts. They have them a couple times a month and they definitely sell out. So if you're wanting to try these don't sleep on them! A second favorite -- albeit not a donut -- are their brownies. They taste like an elevated, gourmet, almost home made, super fishy cosmic brownie. 

My only con is that they are a more pricey treat. Obviously it must be justified since demand is high and they often sell out.

My husband and I have dined here a few times and have always had a great experience. The food is delicious, ambiance cozy and the live music is a nice touch. Our most recent dinning experience (which was back on 2/7) however, was a bit different than previous visits. Without going into excessive detail, there was miscommunication between our sever and the chef in regards to the preparation of my husbands steak. A replacement was brought out quickly however it was an inadequate replacement (by all standards not just ours). We were very disappointed but the way the situation was rectified is the reason we will continue to visit and recommend The Chadds Ford Tavern. The manager, Kate, came quickly over to our table to discuss the situation. She was professional and empathic and ensured we didn't leave disappointed. Her recommendation of the scallop dish as a final meal replacement for my husband was outstanding. We look forward to our next visit. Thanks Kate for being so wonderful!

The food is disappointed and the service was subpar. The kitchen and the waitstaff seamed like the had a Hatfields and McCoy's feud. 
The Portions size of the side was sad.
Small dining room and cosy atmosphere. Very decent pastas and wine for casual Italian dining at an affordable price

By far my favorite out of all of the celebrity establishments around the city. The service was on point and the live music was amazing. Multiple levels to check out different bands. Another huge plus was the super clean bathrooms which is hard to come by in Nashville

Just go to Starkbucks. I was the only one in line and it took 5 minutes to be acknowledged at the speaker and more than 5 minutes to get a simple macchiato. Look I understand you are minimum wage but you need better customer service.

Called in for take out and one burrito was spot on basically because there was no adjustments but the second one was a disaster when specifically requesting no onions , pineapple or beans ... the only thing they got right was no beans and the food was for someone heading out to work or needed to eat and go ... and the. The whole thing is mostly wrong .. no time to get it right by the time drive ll the way back . What a disappointment. They need to learn the word No in ENGLISH!!!

I normally come here all the time with my family! I would say we are regulars! This is the second time I have had an issue. Came here to work on some things with a a group of women. I asked if we could have a larger table. They refused! We are business woman who planned on working for a few hours and enjoying some breakfast. They were not busy, barely anyone in the place. I will not return!

We stayed here for a conference that was being held across the street. With this being the preferred hotel, we wanted to stay here and were extremely disappointed with how unorganized check in was. With a hotel this size and the proximity to the event center, a hotel like this should be much more versed in large groups checking in at once. It took HOURS after our 4pm check in to actually get into our room and with no real apology or anything. We've stayed at many luxury hotels and this one shouldn't be considered one.
Great Service. Delicious desserts. The Creme Burlee Bread pudding was amazingggg #MustTry

Decided to try the burger At IHOP and I will say it was delicious and went with the onion rings as a side which I was surprised was a no charge option instead of unlimited fries but when the burger came I realized why there was no up charge they served 4 onion rings that's right 4 which I thought was somewhat chintzy. The restaurant is clean and the service was acceptable but really was disappointed with the tiny order of onion rings. I also find it surprising that in 2019 digital coupons are not accepted unless a hard copy of the coupon is presented to the server
We found a excellent Chinese restaurant at reno.good food.good service.we'll come back.
I love this pizza. I first tried it  after drinking downtown. Very convenient location and it's obviously super popular for a reason. I get pizza here almost weekly now-totally sober haha!

Atmosphere was nice, serve was cool. Food was awesome! We ate food here, the prices were decent for food. The drink selection was great! The bands playing on both floors were okay for a Saturday. Keep us here for a few hours.. THE ONLY thing that sucked was the female bartenders were wearing some cute sweaters and my wife wanted to purchase one. The bartenders directed us to the booth downstairs to purchase. When we left we stopped at the booth to buy one... but the lady tells us that these sweaters aren't for sale to the public. Well that sucked...

We are from out of town. We found this place on yelp and thought we should give it a try. So glad we did. The staff were so nice. The breakfast sausage was so tender. The ham steak was thick. We will definitely come back to this place when we are back in Santa Barbara.

Food here is amazing. To be honest, I went pre-Covid. My mouth is watering at the thought of the many times I dined here before. And oh, how I miss it. Their menu is different, it's not something you see on other menus around the city. And it's flavorful, whether it's a vegetable or a meat dish. And the drinks, whether from the bar or by the bottle. One time I was there with a friend - no reservation - and got lucky enough to find an empty spot at the bar. I sat down, my friend stood (not for long as the elderly couple next to us left after finishing their drinks) and we ordered cocktails. Then, we ordered dinner (we ate at the bar) and asked for their wine menu. We asked the waiter for his recommendation for a sparkling wine and he suggested this amazing Cava, at a very affordable price (it would have been very easy to steer us towards a more pricey option) that tasted absolutely incredible and paired quite well with our food. I truly can't wait to go back and encourage anyone to do so. Cheers!
Great little coffee shop. Friendly staff and very convenient. It is a nice alternative to Starbucks

Literally THE BEST WINGS IN NASHVILLE!!!!!!!! This place is black owner and the customer service is pretty great! I've tried many MANY wing places in Nashville and this one is TOP-TIER. Try the gold-n-hot & thank me later

Was expecting so much better after reading the reviews. I got the shrimp with eggs, potatoes, and corn. The seasoning was not good to me at all it just tasted very off. Along with their fries which also wasn't my favorite. I've had boils before and I could've probably done better if I made it myself. The food wait was also very long. Some positives were the customer service the people were very nice also there was a lot of different options. I wouldn't go back again it was very disappointing.

Quoted 33 min for my order and was not ready for over an hour. 
They made my order incorrectly, had to go back for correction. No apologies. Food is mediocre for $82.00.
Calzone bland, kids pasta was definitely sitting around before the rest was ready. Meatball parm is horrible. 

I will not be returning.

The bar had some good things going for it. The place is really big and easy to social distance between groups. There were many open spots to play darts, pool, etc and our group had a lot of fun. Our server checked on us often and promptly got us our drinks and food. The drinks were all good and we had no issues with that. On the other hand, the food was some of the worst bar food I've ever had. The biggest issue was the pizza were ordered which had cheese that tasted so bad that it tasted like cheese from a can. I would stay away from the food and stick to drinks in the future.

Blue Fig Cafe is a gem ! Located close to Wegmans another great spot. The food was amazing. I was feeling light so asked for an appetizer with hummus. It was really good. The pita bread came out warm and fresh. I truly enjoyed my experience and want to go back to try more dishes.

This review pains me. My heart is broken that I could not give 5 stars. The Cheesecake Factory is one of my all time favorite restaurants. I love everything about it. This was my first visit to this one here in Tampa. I had the same expectation that I do with any other location. And I can honestly say that I left disappointed. 

First.... who doesn't love the Bread and Butter? I had to ask 3 times for the bread and butter. Finally it came and it was only the Wheat. I love the wheat. But man I would have really loved the sourdough/French bread. Whichever. Lol. And to watch other servers serve it to other tables was sad. 
I ordered the Flatbread Pepperoni Pizza for the first time. The pepperonis were burned. It also came out not sliced. Hmmm... imagine me trying to eat it and it's not sliced. I used my butter knife to cut me a slice. It wasn't to bad. Something different. I thought I had a pic. But nope. 
I ordered the TexMex Egg Rolls for an appetizer. They were pretty good as well. 

All in all it was an OK visit. Will I return? Absolutely.

I am from a large Italian family and love neighborhood Italian food.  This place is GREAT!!!  I am here visiting on business-- meatballs with ricotta, sausage pizza and cannoli -- all of it superb!

Philadelphia you are lucky!  This place rocks!

Wife and I lunch she had a asada burrito, I had # 18.I has asked for no rice give me a little extra beans. wife was pleased with hers, I got a whole plate of refried beans with the 2 ply softshell white corn tortilla pushed into the refried beans to pick up the taco one would have to put hands into bean covered tortilla what a mess. separated the tacos from the plate of refried  beans put on wrapper when tried to pick up taco paper stuck pulling paper off taco hit glass of water drowning my whole meal on water.  ALL ENDED UP IN THE GARBAGE 20 WIFE HAD A $20.00 BURRITO AND I GOT A LESSON NEVER AGAIN

Always consistent, great service and delicious seafood. My family and I are long-time fans. I love the steamed clams and broiled combo, but we have also ordered the soups, raw clams / oysters and other dishes that are always great. It's really laid-back -- the ambiance is very casual and relaxed -- and it's a byob, but we are always happy with our food here and have come back many times.
Haven't had a good pizza from here in a while but tonight we got a really good pizza. Done perfectly. Was so good. Well done!! Just like we like it!!

There's an employee that is so extremely sweaty cutting and hanging over our pizza. It's disgusting. Wear a sweat absorbing t shirt!

Since the owner left this location it's gone downhill and it's a shame because pizza isn't bad.

Unique tasting Latte- Almond with a sight chocolate taste.
Lovely ambience and atmosphere on a Tuesday morning- reasonably quiet and tranquil!
Beautiful stone vintage building on the outside and modern look inside with plug cords and WiFi!
Will definitely visit again and try out their renown Waffles next time.

I'm a huge fan of Skyline Chili and this location is no different! Friendly workers  and good food per usual. This location is different than any other location I have been to. this is cafeteria style with trays and a cash register at the end of the line versus a traditional waite/waitress scenario. There's no barstools, just tables. It doesn't make for a bad experience, just different!

I've been here twice now, once for dine-in and once for carryout. Both meals were flavorful, satisfying, and freshly-prepared. Both times I have tried Thai dishes that I have never tried before and I really liked everything that I ate, but it wasn't the best Thai dishes I have ever had. Their prices seem a little steep for what I expect, but the amount of food served was a LOT. This place seems family-run and I love that. It also seems to be a popular place for UA kids and their families, so on game nights (one of the nights I was there it was a game night of some kind) they were totally buzzing. They handled it well and it seemed to take a few extra minutes for my food to come out but not terribly long. Bangkok Cafe is a little far out of my normal range for a restaurant, but I wouldn't hesitate to drive over if I had wanted some Thai food.

Ok.  I love the McDonald's oatmeal, and normally drive thru 2-3 days per week. Not only is the oatmeal tasty but the drive thru is normally quick and eff.  Unfortunately my experience today was not acceptable after placing and paying for my order at 8:13 they gave me my drink and directed me into their waiting for order spot #1.  After waiting for 13 minutes (an absolutely unacceptable amount of time) I called them 727-943-8721.  When the phone was answered, I gave them my order #1309 and told them that i had been waiting for 13 minutes.  The person who answered said we will get it right out.  So after 15 minutes my quick drive thru food was ready.  
Quality of the Oatmeal very good.
Speed of drive thru absolutely unacceptable

This establishment is wonderful!   The food is excellent, the owners are charming and the vibe of the restaurant just makes a person feel good.  5 stars for sure.   A definite must try if you are in the area!

I 100% stand behind my previous review of Longway Tavern, this place is AMAZING!! I will visit Longway every time I visit New Orleans. The food, drinks, staff and environment are well above any of your expectations! Support your local restaurants and run to Longway!! Delicious!!
Authentic polish cuisine  super delicious I always get the buffalo chicken perogies. But everything else on the menu is also very good! The owners are very sweet too!

Let's begin with service... Lee and her team were absolute amazing to us. First night in NOLA and we can't stop talking about the service, food, and drinks. We were in and out within an hour. They were truly accommodating to us as we need separate checks for work. I will recommend and return to SukhoThai. From the impeccable service to the tantalizing taste of the Thai food to the flavorful drinks, SukhoThai please keep it up.

This hip, vintage-styled diner is slinging classics like biscuits & gravy or waffles with a little added foodie flair. The simple menu is listed on a chalkboard and offers quality, unique meats but some vegetarian options as well. I love their brunch options. Try the pork belly waffle- it's phenomenal! Customers order at the counter here and there's typically plenty of seating so it can be a quick, casual stop for a great meal along Mass Ave.!
Got the beef and broccoli lunch special. This meal was awful. The customer service was okay, but the food tasted old and musty.

We ordered from here last night, and it didn't disappoint. The shrimp scampi was very flavorful. Our son demolished his raviolis. Looking forward to being able to go here soon, but for now we will definitely be ordering from here again.

If you want a delicious Italian meal-then this is the place for you. The chef obviously cares to keep it fresh and yummy, and we had one of the best meals we've had in a while. We ordered the special appetizer and the  broccoli rabe and sausage appetizer-delicious. Soup of the day was a satisfying  roasted red pepper bisque. I took some extra home! The braciole was amazing! All around great service, great food and fairly priced. Will be back!

Oh my gosh, we have eaten here twice now in the past 2 weeks.  Both times the food has been fabulous.  

I cannot seem to get past my obsession with their carnitas burrito.  Just so yummy.  Husband branched out and had their hot seafood soup served in one of those stone bowls on legs.  It was scrumptious and still bubbling because the stone bowl had been heated.  It was full of seafood, shrimp, octopus, clams, crab, squid and more.

We just love this place.  They are very covid 19 compliant and the service was terrific, so were the margaritas!  Our very favorite Mexican food restaurant and for those who love tongue (lingua), they serve that too plus Menudo for the very adventurous which my brother is and we will bring him here when he comes for another visit.  Won't be disappointed if you come here.

This restaurant is fantastic. The staff make you feel at home with their loose banter and quirky personalities. Good great and and a good price too. Definitely recommend to anyone who's wanting a little taste of home.

Time to say goodbye to one of my favorite coffee shops in Reno.  After a good long run, the Bibo on Record Street is shutting its doors, so it is time to send the place out in style.

As many folks are aware, Bibo is one of the most widespread of local coffee shops here in the Truckee Meadows, and have been serving up great coffee, spectacular gelato, cafe snacks, and even beer and wine at their various locations around town.  But it was this location that held a special place in a lot of peoples' hearts, as it was one of the few coffee shops adjacent to the UNR campus, especially on the south side.  It served as a place many of us could snag a cup-o-joe on our way to morning classes, to hunker down and hit the books over a bagel and some tea, or to grab a casual pint after a long day of work or study in a building with so much charm and character.  Plus, it had one of the most unique features I have seen in any coffee shop, that being what amounts to a train drive-thru.  Like seriously, where else are you going to see railroad employees stop their trains, hop out, and come in for a late to-go, then be back on their way up the tracks?  You ain't gonna find that at Starbucks.

As for tonight's visit, it was their official send-off party.  And they went all out, throwing an epic block party.  The coffee and beer were flowing, the music was playing, and outside there were several food trucks serving up all sorts of good stuff to the crowd.

All in all, this was a fun way to bid
Chicken was overcooked and dry. Loco salad was horrible. I will never eat here again.  Changed management and food went downhill real fast and not friendly service at all.
I have eaten here before. It's in Ybor city in Tampa, Florida. It's good for watching soccer games, too.

Just went to this place normally service here is great the married couple treated us soo well, they greet you with a smile makes you feel welcome but today there were some new ladies working there and the one lady with the really thick black eyebrows(sorry don't know her name) was soo rude and they weren't even busy to say they were rushing to get order done faster. Also there Jalisciense aren't the same as before they made them differently this time

Ordered a pizza for the first time at Brooklyn Pizza.  Thought I was getting something like a square Brooklyn pie and my fault but ordered the wrong pie.  Took it home to my surprise a round pie very thin crust nice and crispy with good ingredients the pie was tasty well prepared and satisfying.  Grabbed a menu and will check it out better the next time I order from Brooklyn pizza.  Sorry forgot to take a picture to post here.

I don't know, I get it, but I don't. 

It's a cool building, but old fashioned inside .

It's a complete menu, but not exciting.

Service is attentive, but....unrefined? 

Ordered 3 dishes:
Fettuccini Travolino - chicken fettuccini in an alfredo sauce, then, for show they dump some booze in a cheese wheel, light it on fire throw the pasta in, stir it around, plate it and,  voila!  Its 1983 again!  Taste wise, it's ok, chicken was a bit dry. 

Next up was a stuffed ravioli with a cream sauce.  This was my favorite of the 3 pastas, but I wasn't wowed by it. 

Penne Pollo was #3, slightly spicy tomato sauce, it was ok, same issue with the chicken being a bit dry. 

Desserts are house made, which is good, as are "some" of the pastas. 

Beer menu is not good. (Coors, Canadian, Kokanee etc)

Price wise it's a bit high, and there is better Italian in the city.  It is what it is, it probably has a group of loyal clientele that go once a month...but I think ill go elsewhere next time I want Italian.

The recently remodeled Oceano is fresh and expansive and beautifully designed.  Serene. The bread made in-house is SF Fishermen's Wharf quality. Really recommend it for lunch.  Exquisite scampi. This restaurant has awesome choices for those who don't like fish either. Not much close to its quality in this region.

Definitely need to check out this little sandwich shop if you haven't. Risking my life to pickup sandwiches during this quarantine was one of the best decisions of my life. I had the De Niro which was fabulouso. Chicken cutlet with balsamic, roasted peppers, red onions, arugula, provolone and prosciutto... what a combo. Highly recommend this place!!!

Great dinner Saturday. Amazing mussels, fresh oysters from VA, baked oysters, off the charts bronzino, and a new item on the menu - the best fish tacos ever! Service was spot on, love the atmosphere...a perfect night. 
Almost forgot - the bartender makes a mean dirty martini!
Can't wait to return.

Beyond delicious!!!!!!!!! We will be back for sure. Loved the Grandma pizza and arugula salad! Everything was fresh and fabulous! Thank you to everyone (salad maker and pizza cook) that works there and to Spencer for his friendly welcome & prompt service

I came in with big hopes to like this place, to start the guy in the front is very rude and passive aggressive.  I got there at 7:25pm and ordered my food, he asked if I wanted to eat there or get it to-go, I said for here and he immediately replied "you sure? We are closing soon." They close at 8pm and 35 minutes is more than enough to eat the WORLD's smallest crap roll that costs $16. I already had a bad vibe from him but I still decided to eat there and give it a try. The roll was decent, I could mostly taste the butter and the bread, the tater tots were hard and oily. 
If you're into tiny expensive food, you'll like this place.

This morning I went through drive thru and ordered a big breakfast well after waiting 7 minutes with no cars on line received my food and didn't get any napkins no hash brown or condiments this McDonald's was my favorite but lately it's struggling and when you try calling them the phone is off the hook for hours

Extremely disappointed with our dinner delivery last night. I frequent their Delmar location quite a bit and always have a hearty meal, but we ordered from them late last night and the food certainly wasn't upto mark. 2 stars only because the batata hara.

But the lamb entree was very undercooked and dry, the chicken Shawarma lacked flavor and the labneh's consistency was completely off. Did not have enough cucumber or spice. 

Will not order from here again :(

I ordered online when arriving and waited outside. It only took 15 minutes vs the suggested 30 minutes stated on the website and pick up was easy. Loved the strawberry cream puff and can't wait to be back!

I was dying for a burger , I've tried burgers elsewhere too. The Char taste was nice.. I ordered the Santa Barbara, Two patties, avocado,  tomato, pickles, on toasted Sourdough.. First off messy to eat. The burgers kept sliding off, so I removed the tomato and pickle and that fixed that. So I kept eating and finding it was over seasoned with salt. Ok.. I'm not really picky      but this didn't satisfy my taste buds because of the salt. Restaurant was clean and I like having the vibrating disks that let customers know when their order's ready. The staff was friendly, not a terrible experience....

I'm in town for UNR's graduation as an alumni myself, and I love all the Ijji locations, so when I heard about a new one opening I had to check it out. Unlike the other locations, this one isn't sushi or korean bbq, but a noodle house. The location is nice and modern, the staff are very helpful and attentive when checking out the new food they have to offer. I was recommended to try the black garlic tonkotsu, and man was it tasty. I'm not a real foodie, but it was one of the best meals I've had in Reno. Check it out and don't be afraid to try out something new.

we really enjoyed brunch here. ordered the PB&J biscuit and the hot chicken biscuit- both were delicious! also sampled a few of the different flavored jams and thought they were all tasty.. our favorite was the apple bourbon. 

only negative would be the service seemed slow. we went around noon on a sunday so we expected a bit of a crowd but we wouldn't see our waitress for long periods of time. not sure if they were short staffed or if this is typical service. altogether between waiting for a table & eating we were there for almost 2 hrs

This was AMAZING!!! 

Are you looking for a quick meal that will make you so happy you found that place while filling you up? Well HERE IT IS!!!! 

It's hard to put into words the authentic taste of the seasoned chicken in the tacos. I could taste the chili, the cumin and cilantro in one bite. Then the fresh toppings which they didn't skimp on. I dipped each bite into the little sauces they provided. One was habanero and spicy but tasty AF! The salsa verde was soooooo good. 

I ordered a side of rice which was really tasty! I actually ate the leftovers cold later that night. I just felt like the microwave would eff it up. It was so good. Next time I'm in Philly, I'm going back. 

Seriously, why are you still reading this? Call, order ahead. Wear a mask, stay safe! 
Cash only.

I wanted to support a local business during these trying times.
The bread sticks were hard and the fettuccine barely had enough sauce on it.
I hope they look at the quality before they box it up and bring it to you.

Best Ramen in the Bay Area. There are other good spots, but this place is the best. I get the shoyu and it is phenomenal. My only gripe is that I wish they had more toppings. Like some fried shrimp tempura (or whatever it's called).

Our first Ethiopian meal ... awesome food,  great service,  we will definitely be back. Our server accommodated my need for gluten free bread and made a fresh batch of injera just for us!!! Chill ambiance,  fun music,  but not too loud,  and excellent food. Worth taking a risk on something new and unknown. Looking forward to our next visit!

We walked in for the a quick breakfast and chose this place based on the reviews. After asking the associate behind the counter how are we suppose to order she said if you are ordering in you should sit down and we will serve you. We sat down for 15 minutes nothing happened and we weren't acknowledged. Then we decided to go up there and order ourselves. We ended up ordering an Spanish omelette and tamales and we didn't get our omelettes for 30 minutes. And the interesting fact is it wasn't even busy. So long story short, eggs wasn't anything special. I have had better. But the tamales were very good. One star for service, everybody looks like they just started working here today and three stars for the tamale. Will I come back? Probably not.

Called to place an order to go and the response I got was, "Of course since everyone right now is ordering."
I ordered and then was hit with the, "How are you paying? With card, I'm assuming, since it's the hardest thing to do." 

Sorry for giving you service dude. Maybe don't place your signs all over town if you're not ready for people to call in and order.
